notes.title: Acron Patch 1.17
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/d0adb498fd1a183419b20cc265c3dfde60b3f945.png

Game Updates:
Moved tree branches up a bit to avoid obscuring the player view.
Moved the initial Start button closer to the player, making it easier to reach.
The arrow pointing homeward when holding an acorn is now only visible to the player controlling that squirrel.

Bug Fixes:
Improved throw velocity calculations when letting go of throwables immediately after grabbing them.
The tree/squirrels win text is now correctly sized for Asian languages and updated when changing languages.
Fixed an issue where text styles would not be used when changing between certain languages.
Fixed an issue where multiplayer matches occasionally could not be started.

notes.title: Acron Update 1.16: Localization Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/d0adb498fd1a183419b20cc265c3dfde60b3f945.png

Game Updates:
The game is now available in 10 languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, 
Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese! - You can switch language from the game's settings menu!
Set the window on the main monitor to fullscreen.

notes.title: Game Update 1.14
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/9b68b2966bb29bae27bc11573a8cb2983998234d.png

Minor game update – we added some changes and bug fixes to the game. Enjoy!

Game Updates:
- Changed the mushrooms and pumpkins to fly agaric and pumpkins with faces on the Halloween levels
- Changed color on inactive buttons for VR
- Updated skyboxes on all levels
- Polished textures in Sulky Swamp
- Changed scale on the bushes in Sulky Swamp
- Added a smaller version of update notes inside the game on the mobile side

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed numeric keyboard problem on Google Pixel phones, android version 11. This is a known problem for a lot of developers/apps right now since Android 11 was released.
- Fixed bug where "Tree ended the game" pop up kept showing when it shouldn't
- Fixed bug where acorns could get stuck underground
- Fixed bug where tree could grab squirrels that are in tunnels
- Fixed bug where the end match UI was hidden when settings were visible on mobile
- Fixed bug when the tutorial scoreboard got stuck in the front position after settings was shown

notes.title: Game Update: Sulky Swamp Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Your favorite squirrels are back with a terrifying update including the brand new Halloween themed map Sulky Swamp,  level selection and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/e26d5aa21a617f9828ab17ea5e2615075cba3b40.png

Game Updates:
- New level: Sulky Swamp
- One mobile player required to start game instead of two
- Removed region visuals/simplified room code
- Support emails include extra information
- Notch on some phones is no longer obstructing the view of the game
- Added official iPad support
- A lot of networking fixes
- Made it possible for AIs to have overlaying level structures (like bridges)
- Added new UI for selecting maps and change number of bots
- Added network message for when the tree leaves the match using the exit button which shows a message on the phones that the tree quit the match instead of disconnected
- Made one skin set free (Haunting Horrors skins)
- Gave name to all levels
- Added possibility to adjust number of bots in-between levels 
- Changed how nametags look and behave, below squirrels and are hidden if you can't see the squirrel
- Moved win screen UI on phones
- AI can now throw acorn towards players
- Changed wording on some places
- Made the lobby include less info to make it feel lighter
- Chunk can no longer carry the shield inside a tunnel

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Android crash (OBB)
- Fixed iPhone 6 crash (RAM)
- Fixed issue with Steam not being able to start match
- Fixed bug with player names in the lobby 
- Players can no longer join a game without a name
- Fixed bug with tunnels looping animation when hotjoining
- Fixed bug where the acorn’s location switches between players
- Fixed bug where squirrel name tags become visible when picked up by the tree
- Fixed bug causing delay on continue button when switching between settings and match stats.
- Fixed bug with Chunk animations when not carrying shield
- Bots got stuck in a flickering movement if they were close to the acorn but on the wrong height - Fixed issue with bots getting stuck when close to an acorn
- Fixed bug where knocked out squirrels could go through tunnels
- Fixed bug where music starts over when exiting skin view on mobile
- Fixed bug with adjust bots button being clickable when it wasn’t supposed to be

notes.title: Bug Fix: Android Crash at Start-Up
notes.notes:
We just released a patch that should fix the issue for Android users experiencing game crashes on the start-up screen. Please make sure to update your app if you're using an Android mobile device.

If you are still experiencing this issue after updating the app, please let us know.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update: Various Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We just released an update to fix several reported issues in the game. Don’t hesitate to let us know if you have any questions! 

Don’t forget to update all devices (VR headset and mobiles) with this new patch!

New Features
The tree can now throw squirrels in order to damage other things, just like any other projectile


Bug fixes
(SteamVR) Fixed bug where game would not recenter automatically
(VR) Fixed bug where settings menu would overlaps other UI
Fixed bug where hiding name tags in VR, player name tags in the lobby were not hidden
Fixed bug where tunnels sometimes appeared without entrances or exits
Fixed bug where character portrait did not match chosen skin
Fixed various bugs with networking
Fixed bug that made Chunk's shield able to be planted in mid-air
Fixed bug where squirrels could stop falling by running into walls
Fixed bug where sounds would keep playing after leaving a match

UX
(Android, iOS) Name tags for bots are now visible
(VR) Stop the match from starting accidentally when the VR headset is not being worn
(Android, iOS) Added Twitch to social buttons on media
(Android, iOS) Add option to show/hide player name tags
(VR) URL in VR that informs players where to get the mobile game has been changed to www.acron.game
Settings menu updated
Added links to the troubleshooting guide when encountering issues connecting to a game

notes.title: Release the Haunting Horrors!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/ba79e4d5850c092496a94976894a66193c91809e.png

New game update including the terrifying Haunting Horrors level and 12 cosmetic skins for your favorite squirrel gang. 

Game update: 
 Haunting Horrors level
 12 new skins for the squirrels


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/4d32a078e05f637165440f62890dc22cb599d539.jpg
Haunting Horror skins

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/7053f1e09a7abf3c6941e2d620d18e54830d5e0d.jpg
Jungle Boogie skins

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35214259/324427890e7f535ea9db474bb0ea1d7e9b7b5a7b.jpg
Mobster Madness skins


Bug fixes: 
 Squirrel player nametags can be hidden and shown from the VR settings menu
 Thrown seeds now collide with level boundaries
 Reduced squirrel jittering on mobile when grabbed by tree
 Fixed audio settings not being saved on mobile when game is closed and opened again
 Default number of squirrels set to 4 instead of 2 when creating a room


General bug fixes:
 Optimized game
 Fixed some bugs when joining an ongoing game
 Audio settings are now saved
 Fixed water not rising during overtime
 Added handling for some network errors in VR and mobile
    
Mobile bug fixes:
 Added 'update' screen
 Added 'what's this' screen
 Added social links
 Updated gamepad buttons and layout
 Fixed a bug where joystick would stop working
 Room code is saved when restarting the app quickly  
 Quantizing of network trafic, in most cases reducing the traffic by three fourths

Hope you'll enjoy this new update! 

/The Acron: Attack of the Squirrels! team
